#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Sandboxed Decider runner.

Voters never run in the real working tree. Each seat gets its own throwaway clone of the repository (committed files only,
no remote, hardlinks off), the same full prompt, and the CLI's read-only or restricted invocation where one exists. Votes are
parsed in one place. Afterwards the real tree and HEAD are verified unchanged, and any file a voter wrote inside its clone is
reported as a violation. The clones are removed with safe_delete.

  python decider.py --repo R --proposal-file P [--seats codex,copilot,grok,agy] [--out DIR] [--ref D13 --title T --log DECIDERS.md]

Exit codes: 0 passed, 1 failed (an outlier or no response), 2 usage error, a meaningless proposal, or no fresh probe (the start
probe or a repeat of a stale one failed: no voter was started), 5 the real tree changed.
"""

import argparse
import concurrent.futures
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))

from delete_guard import safe_delete  # noqa: E402
from mob_process import STALE_PROBE_MINUTES, rotation_reason  # noqa: E402
